FeatureCollection with crs urn:ogc:def:crs:OGC::CRS84; every geometry a Polygon; 671 features (a beat can be several polygons), 1,133,037 vertices, at most 15,199 in one feature. Properties are strings: beat '0' is the citywide remainder named 'SAN DIEGO'. The data dictionary (pd_beats_dictionary_datasd.csv) types beat as an integer; calls for service write the same code in their beat column.

title: City Council districts in the San Diego region (polygons)
publisher: SanGIS (City of San Diego and County of San Diego)

licence.evidence: The City's DCAT inventory (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/COSD-PANDA/data-inventory/refs/heads/master/data.json, read 2026-10-08) lists 'City Council districts', publisher SanGIS under the City of San Diego, with this GeoJSON as a distribution and "license": "https://opendefinition.org/licenses/odc-pddl/".

notes: Read 2026-10-08. Every city in the region: 62 features, 9 of them JUR_NAME 'SAN DIEGO' (DISTRICT 1 to 9). No crs member, so RFC 7946 longitude/latitude (CRS84). Polygon and MultiPolygon; 97,293 vertices, at most 10,951 in one feature. NAME is the council member, not the district.
